questions.q: What base class must a Script Include extend to be a valid GlideAjax target?
options: GlideRecord
AbstractAjaxProcessor
GlideAjax
ClientCallable
questions.explain: AbstractAjaxProcessor is the real built-in class that wires a Script Include into the GlideAjax request/response plumbing.

questions.q: A Script Include correctly extends AbstractAjaxProcessor, but a GlideAjax call to it still fails. What is the most likely missing setting?
options: The Script Include record doesn't have the "Client callable" checkbox checked
The Script Include is missing a `type` property
GlideAjax calls never work with AbstractAjaxProcessor
The method name is too long
questions.explain: Extending AbstractAjaxProcessor is necessary but not sufficient — the record also needs Client callable checked, since Script Includes default to not callable.

options: Yes, any method on a Client callable Script Include is reachable
No — the leading underscore marks it as private, so it's never reachable from the client regardless of the Client callable setting
Only if `sysparm_name` is left blank
Only on weekends, per platform scheduling rules
questions.explain: The underscore-prefix convention hides a method from the client even on an otherwise callable Script Include — it's for internal helper logic only.

questions.q: Inside a callable method, what does `this.getParameter('sysparm_active')` do?
options: Starts a new GlideRecord query named sysparm_active
Reads the value the client sent under that sysparm_ name via addParam()
Declares a new client-callable method
Checks whether the Script Include itself is client callable
questions.explain: getParameter() reads values the client passed in with addParam(), matched by the exact sysparm_ name used on both sides.

options: Because `checkDateRange` has a plain, non-underscore name, so it's the public entry point; calling it internally run `_hasOverlap` server-side is fine — only direct client access to underscore methods is blocked
Because `_hasOverlap` is actually callable too, the underscore does nothing
Because `checkDateRange` secretly renames itself at runtime
GlideAjax cannot call any method that references another method
questions.explain: The underscore convention only blocks the client from naming that method directly in sysparm_name — a public method is free to call private helpers on the server.
